title: Retune Swing under causal D-1 regime labels
decision_rationale: the retune selected ema=10 mult=2.5 and that choice is WORSE out-of-sample than the params it replaces
Swing's own contribution under a causal label is negative in BOTH OOS windows under the retuned params, and in 2026 under the old ones
in 2026 the no-Swing route beats every live-tradable Swing route on net, PF, Sharpe, Calmar and drawdown
the brief's bar - do not promote unless OOS evidence supports it - is not met
not DROP_SWING either: two OOS windows, one of them 8 months and ~45 trades, a nine-point grid, no bootstrap, and an unstable selection under BOTH labels

original_process_recovered.source: pooled_swing_wfo.py, credited by futures/basket.py for SWING_TF_PARAM
original_process_recovered.objective: Calmar on the TRAIN fold, minimum 10 basket trades
original_process_recovered.folds: rolling 18mo train -> 6mo test, stepping 6mo, one shared param per fold, pooled across the basket
original_process_recovered.labels_in_original: raw label_regimes dict -> labels.get(day) = the session's own label

provenance_gap.claim_in_repo: SWING_TF_PARAM = ema 30, mult 2.5, max_hold 5 - 'pooled WFO winner, 5/6 folds'
provenance_gap.status: could not be reproduced - NOT 'is wrong'

readings_tried.reading: pooled whole-region Calmar, Track 1 floor config

provenance_gap.consequence: this stage does not claim to have re-run the original tuning; it runs a controlled A/B with one protocol applied identically to both label sets

retune.selection_region: floor only; 2025 and 2026 never read during selection
retune.stability_warning: no parameter wins a majority in either arm; the control has a two-way tie at 4. The frozen ema30/mult2.5 is selected in 1/10 folds under same-day and 2/10 under D-1.

best_causal_d1_params.caveat: a plurality, not a majority; unstable

why_not_drop_swing: two OOS windows, one of them 8 months and 45-48 taken trades
no confidence interval; no difference here has been tested against noise
the grid is nine points in two dimensions - max_hold_days and the context filter were never in it
selection is unstable under BOTH labels (4/10 with a tie in the control)
not_concluded.what_would_settle_it: a causal-label selection over a grid including the hold cap and the filter, with a day-level bootstrap on the OOS windows and a pre-committed threshold

open_items.what: the frozen SWING_TF_PARAM's provenance cannot be reproduced from the script the repo names for it
open_items.why_it_matters: Track 1 Swing runs ema=30/mult=2.5 today on the strength of a '5/6 folds' claim that no reading reproduced
